verdict.rationale: Twenty documents native batch create, update and delete through both REST and GraphQL, plus GraphQL batch upsert. Bulk CSV/XLSX import and unlimited API import cover mass data loading, and workflows include an Iterator step for looping over records. Batches are capped at 60 records per request. Missing for 10: bulk operations above 60 records per call, a documented UI multi-select bulk edit or delete, AI-agent-driven bulk actions, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Both REST and GraphQL support batching up to 60 records per request — create, update, or delete. GraphQL also supports batch upsert
API Import — Large-scale migrations, automation — Unlimited
You can import data for any object using CSV, XLSX, or XLS files.
Workflows can chain any combination of: Record operations... Send email... HTTP request... Code... Branches... Iterator
